notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/33bbdba534639f15d669b0ee16c9740f227e0a4b.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce that several of our word and puzzle games are participating in the "Back to School Games Celebration 2025" on Steam, hosted by Mooncube Games (@SpiritCityLofi)!

If you enjoy exercising your brain while having fun, this is your chance to add some of our titles to your library at a special price.

We also have some exciting news: [b]Mini Words[/b], one of our featured games in this event, will be releasing on[b] Xbox this September 27th[/b]! Be sure to add it to your wishlist on the Xbox Store as well.

The event is happening now and will only run until September 1st. Don't miss out on this opportunity! Check our featured games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana/list/155619]here[/url]

Thanks to Mooncube Games (creators of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113850/Spirit_City_Lofi_Sessions/]Spirit City: Lofi Sessions[/url]) for hosting the even!

notes.title: 🎉 The Music Festival DLC is Out Now! 🎶Plus a Mini Words Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/43160692fda946210ccfacf50e404c8ba30638f6.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!
We're thrilled to announce that the [b]Meow Moments: Music Festival DLC[/b] is now available on Steam! 🐾

🎸 Step into a vibrant open-air celebration where cats and friends gather to enjoy pop, rock, folk, and electronic music. Explore themed stages, cozy camping spots, a dazzling Ferris wheel, and much more — all illustrated by Katia Numakura and set to a chill, festive soundtrack by Tatyana Jacques.

👉 Add it to your game and keep the celebration going!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802160/Meow_Moments_Music_Festival/

[h1]🎮 Mini Words Gets an Update Too![/h1]
That’s not all!
We’ve just released a new update for our word puzzle game, [b]Mini Words[/b] 🎉

🕹️ Now with Gamepad Support – play comfortably with a controller
☁️ Steam Cloud Enabled – keep your progress across devices

If you enjoy relaxed logic word games, it’s a great time to check it out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158290/Mini_Words__minimalist_puzzle/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/828263e2b7a80914de85a50656214af06ef90ce6.png[/img]

Thank you for supporting our cozy games! We hope you enjoy this new DLC and the updates across our catalog.

notes.title: Happy Christmas! Enjoy the Steam Winter Sale! 🎄❄️
notes.content:

Season’s Greetings, dear players! 🌟

The Steam Winter Sale has begun, and we’re excited to share that a wide selection of our games is now available at special holiday discounts! 🎮✨ Whether you’re looking for cozy moments in Meow Moments: Celebrating Together and its DLC's🐾 or relaxing puzzles in Island Farmer 🧩, there’s something for everyone to enjoy this festive season.

📅 Sale Dates: December 19, 2024 – January 2, 2025
🎁 Check out our full collection and deals [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana]here[/url]!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/4bf1cd5539fedcbc25cfd690ca85eb744290f878.jpg[/img]

As we wrap up another wonderful year, we want to take a moment to thank each of you for your incredible support and love for our games. Your joy and feedback inspire us to create more magical experiences.

🎅 Happy Holidays, Merry Christmas, and a Joyful New Year! 🎉
As we celebrate this season, we’d like to extend special wishes to our Christian players, commemorating the birth of Jesus—a time of hope, peace, and love. To all, may your days be filled with laughter, relaxation, and plenty of gaming fun.

Warm wishes,
The Mens Sana Interactive Team ❤️

The wait is over, and we’re thrilled to announce that the Olympicats DLC for Meow Moments: Celebrating Together is officially available! Dive into a world of sports, unity, and adorable cats with our latest release.

🌟 Experience the Thrill: Join cats and characters from around the globe as they compete in friendly and exciting sporting events.

notes.title: Update! New control options and improved camera
notes.content:
Hi, in this update we implemented new [b]Gamepad and Keyboard controls and improved camera controls.[/b]

In addition to the current mouse controls, now you have the option to use a gamepad or the keyboard to navigate the menus, build the island, and to freely rotate and move the camera. Try it!

After the release of this game, we developed Island Cities, where we implemented improved gameplay and camera controls using mouse and keyboard. Then, by porting it to Nintendo Switch, we also implemented required gamepad controls.
So, we brought this option to the Island Farmer players on Steam too. Steam Deck players will greatly benefit from it. 
We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Let's play Dolmenjord - Vilking Islands!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/42c6d9a83597a15644ec5ec1dc89ad3c7411956e.png[/img]

Dolmenjord is a game inspired by Norse mythology, where Vikings need help to organize their buildings and villages and thus solve the puzzles and dominate new lands.

It is available now!

Great for Nordic culture fans who love to be challenged with logic puzzles.

Set up each village according to the rules:
- Place all the available houses and walkway pieces.
- Every house must face the walkway.
-  The completed walkway must give access to the port.

The puzzles are simple in the early islands, but it gets challenging as you advance in the exploration. If you prefer a more relaxing journey, that's fine!
Whenever you want, you can enable the Casual Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/0577d939cf97d6c0faadc7f7a473c1082d2151f5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/0ce7c6cd9022add3519c6fd9c6425d9d2acb7393.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Floating Farmer is a Tilt Five Launch Title
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/94bc29d520955132c2a188df494fc2d88f9a3e7c.jpg[/img]

We're glad that Floating Farmer is a Tilt Five Launch Title, as announced by Tilt Five at GDC 2022.

The official announcement with the full list is [url=https://www.tiltfive.com/updates/tilt-five-announces-official-game-launch-titles]here[/url].

Level up your game night with tabletop holograms! The Tilt Five™ holographic gaming system transforms tabletop and video games into 3D vibrant holographic environments. Using the Tilt Five™ augmented reality (AR) glasses, Gameboard, and Wand controller, you can immerse yourself -- [i]and friends[/i] -- in experiences like never before. Visit Tilt Five's [url=https://www.tiltfive.com]website[/url] to find out how to bring Floating Farmer alive on your tabletop!


[b]Tilt Five at GDC[/b]
The Tilt Five team will be on the expo floor of GDC (Game Developers Conference) showcasing demos. If you are attending the conference, go meet our Tilt Five friends and feast your eyes on great holograms.
Where: Booth #N2925

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716390/Floating_Farmer__Logic_Puzzle/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010274/29a929283c6131f831d9f0ff2969f1fb39794e3d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010274/e2c0afd73ef2a6fba11d03b89837d4196215d6a7.jpg[/img]

Wearing the Tilt Five™  glasses, you'll feel like you're among the clouds, flying over a beautiful field of farms. The farm to be arranged will be at your fingertips, allowing you to explore every detail of the plants and animals, zooming and rotating the farm using the wand.

Use the tip of the wand to select and push the blocks in the desired direction to solve the puzzles. 

See up close the joy of puppies finding their mothers and returning home!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010274/7980a2bc1cd0164afb4f4a5dcb6019395a9eed10.jpg[/img]

To explore these optional features, a Tilt Five™ system is required (available for Windows OS). 
The classic Floating Farmer desktop gameplay is still available for everyone (Windows and macOS). 
 
To learn more about Tilt Five™, visit https://www.tiltfive.com/

notes.title: Floating Farmer is here! Let's play!
notes.content:
In a tiny fantasy countryside, something unusual happened. All the animal farms are now floating like little islands in the sky! 
The paths were shuffled and the baby animals were spread.
Slide the blocks and rebuild the broken paths (remember Rubik’s cube?). 
So you help moms unite the families again and bring the farms back to land.

Floating Farmer is the new logic puzzle game of our Farmer series, with different mechanics.

Play it now!

notes.title: Island Farmer is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/344c38eb4bc78bc1ddf48368fa86f55d7ba57f8f.jpg[/img]

Farms are set up in islands over calm and clear water.
In this tiny fantasy experience, that is easy to do and very relaxing, just like a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

Swap the blocks to recreate the desired island and it will compose the archipelago.

There is no time limit, logic challenges, or resources to manage, so you can calmly just focus on the core mechanics while listening to a soothing soundtrack.
[list]
[*] Click on two blocks to swap them,
[*] Turn the camera around the island;
[*] Zoom in and out to see details or the big picture;
[*] Preview the expected arrangement.
[/list]
As you progress building the islands, see your archipelago expand and evolve in the background.
With clear skies, fresh air, and crystal clear water, among animals and listening to the sounds of nature.


Play it now!

Follow us on Steam and keep up-to-date with our releases!
